espinazo-del-diablo.title: Espinazo del Diablo
espinazo-del-diablo.slogan: Durango to Mazatlan · one way, about 458 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Durango
waypoints.advice: Durango is where the day begins. Next is El Salto.

waypoints.name: Espinazo del Diablo
waypoints.advice: 305 km in you reach Espinazo del Diablo. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Mazatlan, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Durango → El Salto is 97 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
El Salto → Espinazo del Diablo climbs about 2400 m in 60 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Espinazo del Diablo → Mazatlan drops about 2400 m over 93 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: El Salto → Espinazo del Diablo
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 110 km. 2400 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Espinazo del Diablo → Mazatlan
scenicChapters.narrative: 171 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

espinazo-del-diablo.story: From Victoria de Durango it runs 458 km to Mazatlán; allow about 6 h 10 of riding. On the way it passes El Salto and Espinazo del Diablo. The highest point is about 2,500 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

places-cingle-de-la-mola-remigia-abric-v.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cingle-de-la-mola-remigia-abric-v.story: 411 km from Ares del Maestre to Ares del Maestre, about 7 h 05 of riding. The stops in between: Cova de Gargán, Castell de Villafamés, Peñón de Santo Espíritu and Barranc de la falaguera- Abric I. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Tizi n'Tichka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Tizi n'Tichka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
